properties.note: THE BLOCKER, DRAWN AS AN EDGE RATHER THAN LEFT IN PROSE. This requirement wants the release procedure held as an ordered process, and cap:model-process is the Flow machinery that would hold it. It CANNOT yet: PART_OF_FLOW is declared Capability -> Flow and accepts nothing else, so a Flow's steps must be Capabilities, and a release chore is not a capability. Until that widens (a schema change, which moves the stamp), this requirement is unsatisfiable by the vocabulary it needs. Recorded as an edge deliberately — this session's own finding was that a prerequisite written into a description is a trigger nothing fires (cap:what-next sat parked after its condition cleared, because nothing watched the prose).
